title: Concept: Lockfile entry without licence metadata
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry that records no licence, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Redistribution rights cannot be established for a dependency whose licence is unknown, which blocks release review and downstream use.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Redistribution rights cannot be established for a dependency whose licence is unknown, which blocks release review and downstream use.
